portfolioIntro: Over the past decade, our team has worked collaboratively with some of the finest designers and construction firms on a multitude of luxurious projects that spanned across the globe. Our portfolio showcase array of successful ventures, showcasing featuring grand residential projects in from Abu Dhabi, Saudi-Arabia, French Riviera from Monaco to Cannes. Our projects encompass both commercial and residential spheres, featuring expansive office spaces, alongside luxurious residential apartments in Mayfair, Belgravia and Chelsea.
aboutParagraphs: We're a London-based design studio with a talented group of architects, interior designers, and 3D visualizers. Since 2014, we've worked with a wide range of clients and have had the chance to work on many high-end projects across the UK, France, Monaco, Switzerland, and the UAE.

Our team has a wide set of skills that cover interior design and architecture. We work with a variety of clients including private individuals, construction companies, architects, interior and exhibition designers, and property developers.

team.name: Dmitrij
team.bio: Dmitrij is a Senior 3D Visualiser with a highly creative approach and an exceptional eye for detail. A perfectionist by nature, he brings concepts to life through carefully considered lighting, materials and composition, creating imagery that captures both the character and atmosphere of each project.

team.name: Vladimir
team.bio: Vladimir is the founder and creative director of the studio, with over 15 years of experience in interior architecture and 3D visualisation. His approach combines architectural thinking with a strong eye for proportion, materials and detail, guiding projects from the first concept through to their final realisation.

team.name: Victoria
team.bio: Victoria manages the organisation and coordination behind our projects, bringing clarity and structure to every stage of the process. Highly organised and exceptionally attentive to detail, she oversees planning, communication and project coordination, ensuring that both the creative team and our projects stay on track.

team.name: Olga
team.bio: Olga is a Senior Architect with over 15 years of professional experience in architecture and interior design. Her extensive technical knowledge, thoughtful approach and meticulous attention to detail bring precision to complex projects, from architectural development and documentation through to construction and delivery.

projects.title: House at Albert Mews
projects.subtitle: Albert Mews, Famaly house
projects.content:
The house for the young family. The house is located in Romford, London. Surround by greenery which creates privacy and quite environment. Being there you feel as you would be somewhere far in the countryside but in still the middle of the dynamic city. Interior was designed in neoclassical style. The main house had major modifications such as integration of a porch in the hall, bigger bathroom and dressing room for clothes storage space. The house extension made Kitchen bigger allowing to add storeroom and combined created spacious Livingroom. The dining area with conservatory of 7sq.m brought for exotic plants.

This project was crafted using 3Ds Max and rendered with Corona Renderer, ensuring photorealistic visualizations. All CAD drawings were precisely executed with AutoCAD. Our comprehensive design package encompassed 3D visualizations of all interiors within the main and guest houses, as well as the exterior spaces including the car park and pool areas complete with BBQ zones. A complete set of detailed drawings and a finishes schedule were also provided, essential components for the tendering process. The entire project was developed over a four-month period, reflecting our commitment to both quality and efficiency.

projects.title: Villa La Belle
projects.subtitle: Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat
projects.content:
This project is designed togher helping construction company who design and build multimillion properties at south of France. The property included several living rooms, kitchen, two master suites, as well two secondary bedroom suites. Underground car park, lift for two people. The cost of refurbishing and construction was £2,500,000 Villa La Belle is in cap ferret peninsula to the east of Nice, France. Unique landscape of Cap Ferret is a challenging, approximately 30m height difference from lowest to top spot of the property.

Architects came up with the idea to dig down into the rock to win space for the garage which could fit up to 4 cars. The luxurious lift brings you to top floors, allowing to witness fantastic views on Mediterranean Sea as well as properties multi-level gardens. Further up above the house was located outdoor swimming pool and couple of meters higher barbecue area. On the top of the hill observatory was located for guest entertainment watching the start together. Interior was design based on owner’s taste and preferences, in Neoclassical style, with modern elements.

projects.title: Villa At Saadyat
projects.subtitle: Family Villa In Paradise
projects.content:
Family villa at Saadiayt island in Abu Dhabi needed extra touch to become super luxury residence. The budget spent on furniture, refurbishing and landscape design reached £2,000,000. Our work included starting from redesign of landscape to interior design. Relocation of the pool and the interior on ground floor consists of spacious majlis with sitting area and dining table for 12 people, home cinema living room combined with show kitchen and dining area facing the sea and beautiful garden with pool.

On the first floor could be found master suite with two walk-in wardrobes. As well on the same floor was places 5 bedrooms individually design for each of the owner’s children. All the walls are decorated with classic mouldings with silk wallpaper inlays. Floors are white marble slabs, ceilings decorated with cornices, windows treatment tailored using best fabrics from Italian manufacturers such as Rubelli, the furniture brands was used in this project was American brand such baker, Italian Promemoria, lighting Bella Figura.

projects.title: Villa Nudra
projects.content:
This magnificent private villa, spanning 1350 square meters, is perched within the prestigious Nudra development, by the cost of the Gulf Sea. The facade, clad in stone sourced from the Jerusalem, coupled with sleek metal elements, bestows the villa with a unique, modern aesthetic that radiates warmth. The price of the property was £5,000,000 and budget for construction riched approximately £3,500,000.

The structure was initially presented to us as shell and core, providing us with a white canvas to craft a truly bespoke residence, meticulously tailored to surpass the client's highest standards of luxury. A distinctive highlight of this property is the innovative fountain feature within the ground floor gardens, boasting a glass bottom that allows sunlight to cascade into the spa area below.

projects.title: Villa in Abu dhabi
projects.subtitle: Ve4ry nice Villa in UAE Capital near the sea

projects.content:
Located in Saadiyat island it facing most beautiful beaches and blue water coast. projects.title: Villa Luna
projects.subtitle: James bond Villa with view on whole Monaco
projects.summary: James bond Villa with view on whole Monaco
projects.content:
Family villa at Saadiayt island in Abu Dhabi needed extra touch to become super luxury residence. The budget spent on furniture, refurbishing and landscape design reached £2,000,000. Our work included redesign of landscape to interior design, relocation of the pool and the interior design.

The first-floor houses sumptuous bedrooms and a grand master suite, each space crafted with luxurious materials and a serene colour palette to reflect the tranquil surroundings. Ascending further, the roof terrace offers an exclusive escape with an outdoor bar, lounge, jacuzzi, and a fire pit set within a cozy majlis, perfect for enjoying the sweeping views. This villa is not just a home, it's a lifestyle statement, promising a haven of peace and splendour in one of the world's most sought-after locations.

projects.title: Villa At Cap D'Ail
projects.subtitle: Two beautiful houses with vide on Mediterranean sea
projects.summary: Two beautiful houses with vide on Mediterranean sea
projects.content:
Nestled in the picturesque locale of Cap D'ail, near the illustrious Monaco, this dual villa estate stands as a beacon of luxury, meticulously designed by our esteemed client, a renowned construction company with a portfolio of exquisite projects in the South of France. With a generous budget of 20,000,000 million euros, the entire territory has been transformed into an enclave of elegance and refined living. Our client’s expertise in design is evident in the thoughtfully arranged outdoor spaces, where the Mediterranean's natural beauty is enhanced by the serene landscaping, creating an ambiance of tranquillity and privacy. Our team was entrusted with the privilege of bringing these villas to life through detailed 3D visualizations.

The villas rise elegantly against the backdrop of verdant foliage, their spacious terraces offering unrivalled views of the azure sea. Inside, each residence unfolds with an array of amenities from plush living areas to gourmet kitchens, and expansive dining spaces designed for lavish entertaining. Specialized rooms like cigar lounges and wine cellars cater to the refined tastes of those accustomed to the finest in life. The crown jewels of the estate are the leisure facilities — outdoor pools flanked by bars, roof terraces with Jacuzzis, and fireplaces in sunken majlis, all designed for enjoying the panoramic coastal vistas. Our visualizations capture the essence of luxury living, highlighting the seamless integration of indoor comfort with outdoor splendour, a signature of the South of France’s opulent lifestyle.

projects.title: Cannes Villa
projects.subtitle: Luxurious Villa between Nice and Cannes
projects.summary: Luxurious Villa between Nice and Cannes
projects.content:
Nestled within the lush, sun-drenched hills near Cannes, France, stands a 800 square meter private villa, a serene sanctuary that has undergone a remarkable €3 million refurbishment. This exquisite residence, brought to life through our expert 3D visualizations crafted in 3ds Max, is a testament to the seamless fusion of high-end luxury and the tranquil charm of the French Riviera. The landscape included pool area.

Every room within the villa is an ode to refined taste, blending modern aesthetics with the warmth of traditional French design elements. The result is a space that is not only a feast for the eyes but also a haven of comfort. As one meanders through the 3D spaces, the villa tells a story of luxury that is both opulent and inviting. From the grandeur of its stately rooms to the intimate corners designed for relaxation, every inch of this villa has been meticulously planned to create an ambiance of exclusive sophistication.

projects.title: Villa La Fadarello
projects.subtitle: Multi Million Mega mansion at South of France
projects.summary: Multi Million Mega mansion at South of France
projects.content:
This project is design together with the construction company who design and build multimillion properties at south of France. The cost of actual property by itself was over the £70,000,000 million. The design proposal included redesign and refurbishment of the landscape, interior and exterior. The reconstruction cost as proposed was over £20,000,000. New floor layout for all floors, for main house as well as guest house included 6 new bedrooms and master suite.

Outdoor swimming pool with luxurious outdoor kitchen, fountains, Japanese garden with sculptures. One of the features was ability to get to the sea where was parked a bout which could take to owners of this luxurious mega yacht parked in just minutes from this property. Interiors on ground floor included, main entrance hall with cage lift, marble stone staircase. Walls was decorated with stone cladding and lit up by luxurious Crystal chandeliers. The hall area led to The drawing room with its library, kitchen and dining area with the cocktail bar dressed in onyx stone.

projects.title: Belgravia
projects.subtitle: Belgravia’s heart, luxurious home
projects.content:
Situated in the most opulent enclave of London, this property stands as a testament to luxury and exclusivity. Our esteemed client engaged our expertise to craft precise design intent drawings that would serve as a blueprint for the subsequent manufacturing of bespoke furniture, exquisite marble bathroom cladding, and strategic lighting solutions. In this venture, we worked in concert with the client, fostering a collaborative relationship with the architect to ensure a seamless realization of the vision.

Our comprehensive suite of drawings provided meticulous details for bespoke wardrobes in each of the four bedrooms, including the master suite, along with designs for elegant TV units and detailed bathroom wall elevations. The package also encompassed complete floor and ceiling plans for all five rooms, as well as the placements for electrical sockets and other essentials. Additionally, we created sophisticated 3D visualizations for the custom furniture designs intended for fabrication. The clients entrusted the construction to one of London's premier contractors, renowned for their exemplary completion of the Old War Office, now known as 'OWO,' among other prestigious projects.

projects.title: Mega Mansion
projects.subtitle: Elegant Refinement Meets Modern Luxury at Windsor Estate
projects.summary: Elegant Refinement Meets Modern Luxury at Windsor Estate
projects.content:
Nestled in the outskirts near Windsor, the This Estate stands as a testament to architectural excellence and luxurious living. Our latest 3D visualization project brings to life a multi-million-pound property that is the epitome of opulence and tranquillity. Designed together with experienced construction company in colaboration with architects the estate boasts an expansive pool area complete with steam rooms, saunas, and an indulgent beauty room offering a suite of massage therapies. The gym area, featuring a professional boxing ring and Pilates reformer equipment, caters to the wellness and fitness needs of the most discerning clientele. The landscape is an oasis of nature's best, featuring a meticulously designed garden teeming with an assortment of berries and vegetables, all crafted to ensure very best quality.

Adding to the tranquillity is a Japanese garden, a peaceful retreat with lush koi ponds that invite you to pause and reflect amidst the beauty of nature. Every corner of Windsor Estate reflects a dedication to luxury and comfort, from the intimate massage rooms that promise relaxation and rejuvenation to the private gardens that offer an escape into nature's embrace. The outdoor pool area, flanked by stylish loungers and a sophisticated bar, is the heart of social gatherings, where residents can unwind under the starlit sky. Our visualization captures the essence of Windsor Estate – a sanctuary where grandeur meets well-being, designed to exceed the expectations of those who seek an unparalleled lifestyle. With a budget of £5,000,000 every detail is a narrative of luxury, crafted to perfection by our expert team, ensuring that every visual conveys the ultimate in fine living.

projects.title: Chelsea Apartments
projects.subtitle: Modern Apartments in Heart of London
projects.summary: Modern Apartments in Heart of London
projects.content:
Our team of interior architects and 3D visualisers have redesigned a Chelsea contemporary apartment. This project has been rejuvenated to reflect the latest in interior trends while maintaining a timeless appeal. As you traverse through this luxurious space, the extensive use of Travertine stone stands out, lending the apartment both warmth and grandeur. The walls, adorned with silk-effect coverings in pastel taupe, exude a subtle sophistication that complements the soft pastel colour palette chosen for its feminine grace and serenity. The living area, designed to be both stylish and functional, harmonizes soft furnishings with sleek modern fixtures, creating an inviting atmosphere.

The delicate interplay of natural light and the high-quality, luxurious materials accentuates the spaciousness and refined aesthetic. In the kitchen, precision-crafted surfaces and state-of-the-art appliances are set against the rich textures of the stone, presenting a culinary setting that is as delightful to the senses as it is practical. The bedroom a sanctuary of tranquillity, speaks to the pursuit of minimalistic opulence. This Chelsea apartment, now reborn through our expert design and visualization, stands as a paragon of elegance, offering our client a refreshed living experience that is in step with the evolving tides of interior design.
